fieldContext.note: Perfection Point = Most favorable level of performance, beyond which additional capacity yields zero extra value. Fail Point = Least favorable level, below which system is non-viable.
fieldContext.source: SWEBOK v4.0 Section 3.2 / Tockey 'Return on Software'

personalNotes: QoS cost to deliver is a step-function (investment increases capacity up to discrete performance plateaus). Maximum economic return occurs where value minus delivery cost is maximized.
